messages:
Maria Chen: Quick post-EBR summary — thanks everyone who joined. I pulled together a short action digest and an onboarding-signal snapshot. Slides and raw notes here: https://drive.redwood.example/qbr/2026-03-21 (see v3 in /shared).

Kevin Patel: Thanks Maria. Two quick asks: who owns the 'at-risk feature rollout' slide, and can we add a one-line SLA ask for Dedicated customers?

Olivia Brooks: I updated the onboarding status table in the sheet — flagged 3 accounts with delayed API key issuance (RedFox, Northlake, Harborline). Uploaded the CSV export + a screenshot to the shared folder. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/qbr/2026-03-21/onboarding_status.csv

Sanjay Rao: AE note — RedFox and Northlake execs asked for a cost vs performance breakdown and a single-slide recommendation for renewal. If we can prep a 1-slide summary with numbers (QPS, avg token cost) that would help. Assigning to @Maria for the narrative.

Maria Chen: Assigning owners: Maria -> 1-slide exec summary; Olivia -> technical appendix + onboarding docs; Kevin -> renewal risk bullets. I'll PR the updated deck (v3) by EOD Thu. :calendar:

deploy.bot: Reminder: QBR deck v3 uploaded to /shared/qbr/2026-03-21/v3.pdf (checksum: abc123).

Kevin Patel: Also proposing we include an explicit demo fallback playbook in the ops appendix. Draft snippet: ```If latency spike > 200ms sustained for 3 minutes -> route traffic to quantized variant (q4f16) + enable prefix KV caching for session users + notify AE and SE via crm tag 'latency-fallback'.``` Thoughts?

Olivia Brooks: :thumbsup: I'll add that under 'Operational fallbacks' and include the Dedicated config snippet (example patch for route policy + NGINX / Envoy snippet).

Maria Chen: Capture of feedback items from the meeting: 1) clearer key rotation examples (terraform + CLI), 2) a short onboarding checklist for first 2 weeks, 3) renewal outreach cadence aligned to usage spikes. Olivia — can you link the terraform template into the technical appendix?

Olivia Brooks: Done — added terraform/key_rotation.tf example and inline comments to the appendix. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/qbr/2026-03-21/appendix/key_rotation.tf

Sanjay Rao: I'll push renewal outreach tasks into CRM and tag the at-risk accounts. Target ETA: Fri 12pm PST.

Maria Chen: Please add one concrete next step per owner to the actions tab in the spreadsheet (shared link above) by EOD today. If you cannot, post blockers here. I'll close the thread after the PR merges.

Kevin Patel: Ack.

Olivia Brooks: Will do — adding technical acceptance criteria and sample curl commands to the appendix.

Sanjay Rao: Noted — will include proposed exec invite language for the renewal outreach.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Closing loop once v3 is merged and the one-slide summary lands in the exec folder. :white_check_mark:
